hints.title: How to get a DigitalChannel from the hardware map
hints.content: Use `DigitalChannel limitSwitch = hardwareMap.get(DigitalChannel.class, "limitSwitch");` -- the same pattern as getting a motor, but with `DigitalChannel.class`.

hints.title: Setting the mode to INPUT
hints.content: After getting the DigitalChannel, call `limitSwitch.setMode(DigitalChannel.Mode.INPUT);` to configure it for reading.

hints.title: Understanding the inverted state
hints.content: `getState()` returns `false` when the switch is pressed and `true` when it is not pressed. You can use `boolean isPressed = !limitSwitch.getState();` to make the logic more intuitive.

hints.title: Full solution structure
hints.content: Read the state, then use an if/else: `if (!limitSwitch.getState()) { liftMotor.setPower(0.0); } else { liftMotor.setPower(0.5); }`
